title: Grant the read roles the folder-move audit asked for
context: Jennilyn's folder move (2026-11-18 14:23 MT, into 'Vox Company Folder') broke nothing. The audit was refused a few reads; these read-only roles let Claude check functions, schedulers and folder org policies without the write account. Scheduled queries have no read-only role, so they stay on claude-operator.
action:
gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding voxdatalake --member=serviceAccount:claude-readonly@voxdatalake.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/cloudfunctions.viewer --condition=None --configuration=default
gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding voxdatalake --member=serviceAccount:claude-readonly@voxdatalake.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/cloudscheduler.viewer --condition=None --configuration=default
gcloud resource-manager folders add-iam-policy-binding 232835607810 --member=serviceAccount:claude-readonly@voxdatalake.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/orgpolicy.policyViewer --condition=None --configuration=default
Keep reading these through claude-operator; no grant recommended.
